dialogue.text: Good morning, class! Today's lesson: How to sleep in just 10 minutes.
Is that even possible, Professor?
Of course! Cats sleep 16 hours a day. We are the experts.
Step one: Find the warmest spot in the room.
*already asleep on a sunbeam*
Step two: Curl into a tight ball. Reduce surface area.
Like this? *curls up*
Perfect! Step three: Close your eyes and think of tuna.
I'm already dreaming of tuna... zzz...
And that's how you sleep in 10 minutes. Class dismissed!
Today's lesson: How to grow your money. The cat way.
Do cats even use money?
We use treats, and treats are currency. Pay attention.
Rule one: Save your treats. Don't eat them all at once.
*eats all treats*
Mochi! You just ate your entire savings!
I regret nothing.
Rule two: Hoard things. Random objects have value.
Like bottle caps and string?
Exactly! You're basically running a bank now.
Today's lesson: How to find a job. The cat way.
I already have a job: being adorable.
That's called freelancing. But let's talk formal employment.
Step one: Look available. Sit in a box at the store.
I sat in a box once. Someone tried to buy me.
See? It works! Step two: Network. Rub against everyone's legs.
What if they don't have legs?
Then they're not your target employer.
Step three: Demand treats. If they don't pay, leave.
I demand treats right now.
Today's lesson: How to wake up early. Ironic for cats.
I wake up at 5 AM every day!
Exactly! And what do you do at 5 AM?
Scream at my owner until they feed me.
Perfect technique. Step one: Set an internal alarm.
Step two: Stare at your owner until they feel your presence.
What if they don't wake up?
Step three: Gently tap their face with your paw.
What if they still don't wake up?
Step four: Sit on their face. Works every time.

title: How to stay calm under pressure

dialogue.text: Today's lesson: How to stay calm under pressure.
I panic when the vacuum comes out!
Classic mistake. Step one: Identify the threat.
If it's a vacuum, run under the bed. Strategic retreat.
What if it's a cucumber?
That's a code red. Jump three feet in the air.
What about real danger?
Step two: Look unbothered. Act like you meant to do that.
Step three: Groom yourself. Nothing says calm like licking your paw.
*knocks over vase* I meant to do that. *starts grooming*
Today's lesson: How to make friends. Cat edition.
I'm already friends with everyone!
That's because you're a social butterfly. Not everyone is.
Step one: Slow blink at them. It means I trust you.
*stares without blinking*
Mochi, that's called staring. It's creepy.
I thought I was being friendly!
Step two: Bring them a gift. A dead mouse works well.
What if they don't like mice?
Then they're not worth befriending. Next!
